description: This Java source file defines the 'DiagnosisAttribute' class, which extends 'BaseAttribute' and implements 'Attribute'. It models a diagnosis attribute associated with a diagnosis entity in the OpenMRS healthcare platform, providing getter and setter methods for diagnosis attribute ID and the associated diagnosis object.

classes.name: DiagnosisAttribute
classes.description: Represents an attribute for a diagnosis within the OpenMRS platform, including methods to get and set diagnosis attribute ID and associated diagnosis.

methods.name: getDiagnosisAttributeId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the diagnosis attribute.

methods.name: setDiagnosisAttributeId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the diagnosis attribute.

methods.name: setDiagnosis
methods.description: Associates a Diagnosis object with this attribute.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of the diagnosis attribute, overriding the method from OpenmrsObject.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the diagnosis attribute, overriding the method from OpenmrsObject.
